integrity: The graph, every face, every Hasse cover, the complete Morse orientation, and the mod-2 chain complex are regenerated from definitions by the bundled standard-library verifier. The verification is same-model reviewed and has not received an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite homotopy calculation for the 5-folded cube only; it does not classify higher folded cubes. Public tables already contain the independence polynomial and Euler characteristic, and an equivalent homotopy computation could exist under an unindexed alias.
title: The Clebsch independence complex is a wedge of nine 3-spheres
